# NYC Taxi — Trips by Day of Week

```{tags} reference, query-template, nyctaxi
```

> [NYC Taxi](../../nyctaxi.md) benchmark · [all NYC Taxi queries](index.md)

Trip patterns by weekday

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  EXTRACT(DOW FROM pickup_datetime) AS day_of_week,
  COUNT(*) AS trip_count,
  AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_distance,
  AVG(total_amount) AS avg_fare
FROM trips
WHERE
  pickup_datetime >= '2019-07-29' AND pickup_datetime < '2019-10-27'
GROUP BY
  EXTRACT(DOW FROM pickup_datetime)
ORDER BY
  day_of_week
```
